en: \[VSCode] Fixed the permission mode indicator showing Default while the session kept running in auto or bypass mode after an automatic switch out of it failed; the switch is now retried until it lands
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了自动切换出 auto 或 bypass 模式失败后，session 仍在 auto 或 bypass 模式下运行、但权限模式指示器显示 Default 的问题；现在会重试切换直至成功
